# Vendored files

## WASIp3 C runtime (`vendor/wasip3-sysroot`)

Prebuilt wasi-libc for `wasm32-wasip3` (cooperative threads, clang 23), so the
default build doesn't need clang. Taken unchanged from
[satellite-simple-git-server](https://github.com/Zaiyiiiiii/satellite-simple-git-server).
See `vendor/wasip3-sysroot/README.md`.
